title: Bitcoin ETFs: Money Is Leaving Fast. What Does It Mean?
caption: Nov 25: Reports from CryptoNews and BitPinas say US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw large net outflows, about 1.8 billion dollars last week and roughly 570 million in one recent day, per SoSoValue data. Educational only. Not financial advice. AI-generated voice. Do you follow ETF flows before reading a price chart? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: CRYPTO NEWS
scenes.hook: BITCOIN ETFS ARE LOSING BILLIONS. WHY?
scenes.narration: Bitcoin E T Fs are losing billions. Why does it matter?

scenes.head: THE NUMBERS
scenes.sub: ETF OUTFLOWS LAST WEEK, REPORTS SAY
scenes.narration: Reports say US Bitcoin E T Fs lost about one point eight billion dollars last week, the most since June.

scenes.head: THE LATEST
scenes.hook: ANOTHER BIG OUTFLOW HIT ON TUESDAY
scenes.narration: Reports also say roughly five hundred seventy million dollars left in a single recent day.

scenes.head: WHAT IT MEANS
scenes.hook: E T F HOLDERS ARE SELLING SHARES
scenes.narration: An E T F outflow means investors cashed out shares. It shows mood, but it cannot predict what comes next.

scenes.head: THE LESSON
scenes.hook: FLOWS SHOW MOOD, NOT THE FUTURE
scenes.narration: Learn to read flows as one clue, never as a promise.
